_meta.title: Dub voice (Chatterbox multilingual)
_meta.description: Dub video tool, voice step with the Chatterbox engine. LoadAudio reads the clip's own audio track and TrimAudioDuration keeps the first 10 s as the speaker reference. ChatterboxMTLTTS (wildminder/ComfyUI-Chatterbox, Resemble AI Chatterbox multilingual v3, MIT) speaks the translated script in the target language with the cloned voice; crash protection is off because the script is short. SaveAudioMP3 writes audio/adrift_dub. Builder: buildDubVoiceChatterboxWorkflow in src/lib/oj/dubVideo.ts.
